# ── About ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

> Julian Johnson is the founder of Unified Solutions Inc., an ICF PCC (Professional Certified Coach) and ACTC (Advanced Certified Team Coach) with 1,200+ coaching hours and 222+ clients. He is faculty at ExecOnline and Emeritus, and has guided leaders through advanced leadership programs in partnership with 20+ top business schools including Berkeley Haas, Chicago Booth, Columbia, MIT Sloan, Stanford GSB, Wharton, and Yale SOM.

> His background spans U.S. Army tactical leadership (Kosovo, Iraq), Fortune 500 consulting (Optum, Wells Fargo, Securian Financial), and a holistic coaching practice serving senior executives, leadership teams, and peer advisory circles.

# ── Services ────────────────────────────────────────────────

## 1:1 Executive Coaching
For senior leaders navigating high-stakes decisions, transitions, and identity questions. Holistic in scope, laser-focused in method. ICF-credentialed. Assessment-informed.

## Group Coaching
Peer cohort programs proven at scale through ExecOnline and Emeritus partnerships with top business schools. 6–12 week structured cohorts.

## Peer Advisory Circles
ICF-credentialed facilitation for executive peer groups. Monthly or bi-weekly format. Grounded in COO Forum and UFacilitate peer circle methodology.

## Team Coaching
ICF ACTC-level team coaching. Addresses trust, accountability, and team dynamics at the level where they actually break down. 60–90 day engagements.

## Organizational Coaching
VP cohorts, leadership workshops, and coaching culture development. Enterprise clients include Navy Federal Credit Union, Cognizant, Lawson Products, and Panasonic.

# ── Credentials ─────────────────────────────────────────────

- ICF PCC — International Coaching Federation Professional Certified Coach
- ACTC — Advanced Certified Team Coach (ICF)
